name: bm-remove
description: C→S bm.remove (protocol 1.6, D-13/D-14): remove ONE bookmark or ONE EMPTY folder. String `nodeId`, the bm.open shape. `removeTree` is never called anywhere in the phase, so a subtree wipe from the phone is structurally impossible; Chrome's own kFolderNotEmptyError is the third line of defence. Fire-and-forget — no err reply.
